title: tighten_script_for_runtime_cap
why: edge-tts English deadpan voices ~0.52-0.55s/word; +~0.5s loop flash. Any script >118 words risks 63s Shorts cap.
when_to_trigger: writescript emits a script whose sum(len(seg.text.split()) for seg in segments) > 118
what_to_do: Loop: drop lowest-signal words (filler transitions, articles before proper nouns, adjective doubles like beige-metallic) until <=118 words. Preserve news-hook figures, peak joke anchor, value card anchor. After each cut, re-verify pops are still VERBATIM substrings (<=26 chars).

idea: Numbered chip 1-5 + persistent N/5 counter for five_things (Nexon slot)
why: CarWale + MotorOctane use synced numbered chips as a visible progress bar; our five_things renders lack it. Predicted lift on completion for hype persona.
how: Add chip overlay track: chip index i appears at item_i.start, exits at item_i.end; small 'i/5' locked top-right for full item duration. Cyan-on-figures palette matches approved house style.

idea: ALL-CAPS superlative-verb first word on Nexon hook overlay
why: MotorOctane repeats SHOCK / SHOULD / NEVER / ONLY as first word in Shorts overlays - pattern-interrupt for hype persona. Our hooks lead with product name, missing the stopping-power verb.
how: Writer emits hook starting with ALL-CAPS trigger verb (candidates: SHOCK, NEVER, ONLY, MUST). Renderer punches with stinger + white-flash on frame 1. Body copy remains sourced/verified.

idea: Binary comment-bait CTA on tail card (Nexon or Brezza - 1 or 2?)
why: MotorOctane engagement lever; we end with verdict + LSS reaction but harvest no poll signal. Reply-rate boosts recommender push.
how: Append 1.2s tail beat AFTER approved LSS reaction: two chips '1 Nexon | 2 Brezza' with comment arrow. Do NOT replace LSS - extend runtime ~1s or steal from mid-beat trim.

idea: Authority chip in first 1.5s (CARDEKHO SPEC / SPEC SHEET)
why: CarWale + carwow anchor trust with source chip inside hook; we bury sourced-sheet fact origin. Visible source chip separates us from unverified reels and reduces 3s cliff drop.
how: Renderer draws small top-left source chip during 0.0-1.5s of hook (cyan pill, 22px, 'CARDEKHO SPEC' or 'SPEC SHEET'). Sourced from recipe fact_source field; if absent, chip skipped (never fabricate).

title: detect_cta_needs_lss_phrase
why: Renderer auto-draws the like/share/subscribe icon strip only when the narration literally speaks the three words in order. A CTA that skips them silently loses the graphic — owner requires it on every CTA.
when_to_trigger: writescript or editor emits a script whose final segment (role='cta') does NOT match /\blike\W+share\W+subscribe\b/i on seg.text
what_to_do: Rewrite the last ~6 words of the CTA to end with '— and like, share, subscribe.' (or an equivalent that keeps the three words adjacent in order). Preserve the which-car-next comment-bait question. Re-run structural_citation_check + unsourced_numbers_check.

title: reject_cta_with_lss_text_pop
why: The engine draws the LSS graphic word-exactly on 'like/share/subscribe'. A hand-written text pop with those words would render duplicate labels — one text, one icon strip — cluttering the CTA.
when_to_trigger: any pop in a cta segment whose 'show' text contains any of {like, share, subscribe} (case-insensitive)
what_to_do: Delete the pop. If the CTA still needs a rail pop, choose an anchor from the comment-bait question (e.g. 'YOUR PICK.' anchored on 'which car next' words).

why: owner shortlisted Anika 2026-07-22; blocked on $5/mo tier; measure retention delta when unblocked

title: empty_rework_feedback_bounces_no_escalation
why: Owner clicked 'Needs rework' on hyundai-creta with rating=4 and notes/beat_tags/beat_wins all empty. Previously the flow escalated to the paid deep brain, which is a ledger-#1 hazard (invent-a-removal). Free brain must NOT invoke LLM or mechanic when there is zero explicit signal to act on.
when_to_trigger: rework.run() with verdict='rework' AND notes.strip()=='' AND beat_tags=={} AND beat_wins=={}
what_to_do: Short-circuit: flip card status back to 'awaiting_approval' with a note asking the owner to tag beats / leave a note (or click Approve). Skip _fold_learnings, _notes_to_actions, _punch_up_tagged, _render_directives, mechanic escalation, and re-render entirely. Log kind='rework_empty' to data/brain_log.jsonl.

asked: You clicked 'Needs rework' on the Creta draft with rating 4/5 but the notes/beat tags/wins were all empty. The mechanic did NOT change anything (per ledger #1 — never invent removals without your explicit words). The 60.7s / QA 12/12 green draft is unchanged and back in the queue. If you meant to APPROVE, click Approve. If you meant to REWORK, tag the weak beats or add one line about what you want changed (e.g. 'peak feels flat', 'card holds too long', 'add music'), then click Needs rework again.
